How to Install Messages App:
- Open any iMessage
- Tap “App Store button” (right of camera button)
- Scroll all the way to the right and tap “More” button (3 dots)
- Tap “Edit” (top right corner)
- Scroll down and switch on “Emoji+”

How to Install Keyboard
- Open the app
- Tap “Add Keyboard” button
- Tap “Add Now”
- Tap “Let’s Go!” (will redirect to Settings)
- Tap Keyboards
- Switch on "Emoji+"
- Switch on Allow Full access
- Tap Allow

GAMEPLAY
